create_single_scene_sampler: create a SingleSceneSampler that always returns the same scene string on sample
create_multi_scene_sampler: create a MultiSceneSampler that uniformly samples from a list of scene strings
sample_scene: call sample on a SceneSampler to get a randomly selected scene string
count_scenes: call num_scenes on a SceneSampler to get the total number of available scenes
implement_custom_scene_sampler: implement a custom SceneSampler subclass with sample and num_scenes abstract methods
